description: Daily digest generator daemon. Runs at 07:00 UTC daily (check hour in loop). Generates DAILY_DIGEST.md with: new MCPs discovered (24h), verdicts changed, new threat intel, risk tier changes, top 5 highest risk servers, pipeline health summary, build activity summary. ws_write digest summary to mesh_events event_type=daily_digest. Attempt email to robin.craib@gmail.com via api.zo.computer/zo/notify best-effort. Poll 3600s checking hour==7 UTC. Heartbeat.
